predictions.source_summary: User-provided URL pathname via req.url -> decodeURIComponent -> path.join with base directory -> request.fullPath
predictions.sink_summary: htmlls() function generates HTML directory listing and pipes to HTTP response
predictions.guard_summary: Method restricted to GET only; dot files blocked if nodot enabled; indexing must be enabled; fs.stat validates path exists; no path traversal protection beyond base directory join
predictions.risk_pattern: User-controlled path directly used for directory listing without traversal validation - allows listing any directory under base path
called_function_context: htmlls() - external HTML directory listing module

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
top_sast_rules.description: Extracting files from a malicious ZIP file, or similar type of archive, without validating that the destination file path is within the destination directory can allow an attacker to unexpectedly gain access to resources.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement path validation using canonical paths. Reject paths containing '../' or similar traversal sequences.
